title: `built` passes over a build whose image run GitHub lists under a later commit
foundBy: session agent, while tracing which commit ui's publish images runs record
details: A run that `ci` finishing starts is listed under whatever commit is main's head by then, not the commit `ci` built. `built` pairs a `publish images` run with a `ci` run by that listed commit. A fix is then never named when a ledger-only push lands while its `ci` runs. Its image run is listed under the ledger commit, which has no `ci` run. A commit can also be credited with another's images. Push C, then D while C's `ci` runs: C's image run is listed under D, even if D's own fails. In ui, the image run started by one commit's `ci` finishing was listed under the next commit, pushed while that `ci` ran. `built` also reads only the newest 100 runs of every workflow together, so enough `ledger` and `pages` runs push the last `ci` pass out of view.

notes.text: `built` no longer pairs runs. A commit counts once ci passed on it and its version is in every image repository the project publishes to, read from the registry's tag lists. `publish images` still posts its commit status, which the file does not read.
